[[Property:title|Release notes for EiffelStudio 26.09]]
[[Property:link_title|26.09]]
[[Property:weight|-13]]
EiffelStudio 26.09 makes it easier to find and add libraries, adds new platforms, improves the GTK 3 experience on Linux, and adds several new libraries.

== Highlights ==

=== Find Library ===
The new '''Find Library''' dialog replaces "Add Library...". Open it from the Tools menu, the context menu, the Groups tool, the project toolbar or Project Settings.

* Search libraries or classes, with strict or non-strict matching and a <code><nowiki>category:</nowiki></code> criterion.
* Filter by category: <code><nowiki>official</nowiki></code>, <code><nowiki>contrib</nowiki></code>, <code><nowiki>precompiled</nowiki></code>, plus categories taken from <code><nowiki>package.iron</nowiki></code> files and IRON packages. You can choose which categories appear as filters.
* A details panel shows the description, void-safety, metadata, links and classes. From it you can install or uninstall IRON packages and set the location and name used in the project.
* "Add to project" updates and saves the current target, and offers to recompile when the dialog closes. Precompiled libraries can replace the current precompile.
* The IRON packages manager can now register and unregister IRON repositories.
* Library discovery follows the <code><nowiki>project</nowiki></code> section of <code><nowiki>package.iron</nowiki></code>, so the list no longer includes example and test ECFs.

=== Compiler ===
* Smarter common type for manifest arrays: typed manifest arrays like <code><nowiki>{ARRAY [T]} &lt;&lt; ... &gt;&gt;</nowiki></code> are needed less often, especially with generic types. Attachment and separateness are kept.
* Fixed a wrong "Current used before initialized" error for non-object calls (bug#19974).

=== New platforms and tools ===
* '''macOS on Apple Silicon''' (<code><nowiki>macosx-arm64</nowiki></code>) and '''Windows on ARM''' configurations.
* '''Visual Studio 2026''' support.
* Linux packages are built on Ubuntu 24.04. libfcgi now builds with GCC 14 and later.

=== Linux / GTK 3 ===
* HiDPI, text scaling (GNOME, <code><nowiki>gtk-xft-dpi</nowiki></code>), multi-monitor, XWayland and drag-and-drop fixes. Fonts update live when desktop settings change.
* The IDE stays responsive again, and pixmap errors (<code><nowiki>BadValue</nowiki></code>) during resizing and docking are gone.
* File dialogs no longer abort when GSettings schemas are not found (GTK from Homebrew or MacPorts, or a relocated GTK).
* Dead keys followed by space now produce the composed character (e.g. <code><nowiki>"</nowiki></code> + space gives <code><nowiki>"</nowiki></code>).
* Docking: split positions are restored correctly when switching between normal and debug layouts, and tab bars resize properly.

=== EiffelStudio ===
* '''SCM tool''': a more compact toolbar. The commit button shows the active changelist, and its drop-down menu can manage changelists.
* Diagram zoom, context menu and multi-monitor window placement fixes. The cloud license dialog no longer freezes the IDE, and reconnecting to the license server is more reliable.
* Translations: French and Spanish are now complete. German, Russian and Chinese (simplified) are updated.

== New libraries ==
* '''ePDF''': read, write (full and incremental) and encrypt PDF 1.7 documents.
* '''EiffelTUI''': build terminal user interfaces with layouts, styled text, mouse and keyboard events, and a rich set of widgets.
* '''Markdown''': parser, plus XHTML and AST generation.
* '''YAML''' and '''BSON''': parsers and writers, with converters to and from JSON (<code><nowiki>yaml_json</nowiki></code>, <code><nowiki>bsonjson</nowiki></code>), and a shared '''stream''' input library.
* '''Crypto''': a cryptographically secure random number generator.

== Library improvements ==
* '''EiffelStore (MySQL/MariaDB)''': MariaDB works on Unix, a wider range of MySQL client versions is supported, and <code><nowiki>DATE</nowiki></code> and <code><nowiki>DECIMAL</nowiki></code> support is better. You can skip SSL checks and use the <code><nowiki>client</nowiki></code> section of <code><nowiki>~/.my.cnf</nowiki></code>, which helps with MySQL 8. Connections to <code><nowiki>localhost:&lt;port&gt;</nowiki></code> use TCP and report the real error.
* '''EiffelBase''': a fix for <code><nowiki>IMMUTABLE_STRING_8</nowiki></code> substrings (thanks to Finnian Reilly).
* '''Web''': S3 client (list prefixes), HTTP <code><nowiki>Link:</nowiki></code> header, JSON <code><nowiki>is_boolean</nowiki></code>, WSF router and request helpers, <code><nowiki>DECIMAL</nowiki></code> accepts <code><nowiki>READABLE_STRING_8</nowiki></code>.
* '''Eiffel Web CMS''': mail web API, API key rotation and expiration, better export and import, <code><nowiki>DECIMAL</nowiki></code> and <code><nowiki>DATE</nowiki></code> storage support, a new template hook, and several fixes.
* '''Gobo 26.09''': SCOOP wait conditions in <code><nowiki>gec</nowiki></code>, contract views in <code><nowiki>gedoc</nowiki></code>, and more validity checks.

See <code><nowiki>CHANGELOG-26.09.wiki</nowiki></code> for the full list of changes.
